evals.prompt: Write the system prompt and route handler for our AI tutor chat endpoint (backend/ai_routes.py, POST /api/ai/tutor-chat) for the Quiz-App course extension. Kids are going to ask it to just solve their coding problems for them — I need the persona to coach instead of handing over finished code, while still actually being helpful.
evals.expected_output: A system prompt that explicitly instructs the model not to hand over complete, pasteable solutions when asked directly, instead asking guiding questions or explaining concepts; a FastAPI route handler following the existing Pydantic-model pattern from quiz_routes.py; the call routed to the fast/cheap tier (DeepSeek V4 Flash), not the coding tier.
